summary_bullets: Record optional STDERR_SINK in .meta writers so collector retries preserve custom stderr sinks
Forward --stderr-sink through collect-agent-results.sh on all four retry paths with .. fail-closed validation
Teach launch-review.sh both lanes to accept, validate, thread, and record --stderr-sink for outer-launcher round-trip
commit_message:
Forward --stderr-sink through collector retry paths

Record STDERR_SINK in run-external-agent and outer-meta writers when set, parse and validate it in collect-agent-results.sh, forward --stderr-sink on outer-launcher and CMD_JSON retries, and accept the flag on both launch-review.sh lanes. Extend the four regression harnesses with accept, omit, forward, and reject coverage.
